scope: Explicit opt-in unchanged retained INSERT-shaped 2D projection, derived from the selected reader-bound TABLE model and jointly validated with the existing source bundle. No output authorization or block-membership evidence.
implementation: The expected projection is a deep DRW_Insert copy of the bounded private reader TABLE snapshot, with proxy bytes/count cleared and replay authorization revoked exactly as dx_iface::addInsert does for a complete TABLE.

On sealing and each query, the adapter requires one concrete INSERT with the selected handle among model-space and retained block entities. Block and total entity counts are bounded at 100000 before traversal; duplicate matching identities, failed capture, absent projection and allocation failures fail the whole stronger selection.

The projection comparator checks bitwise common/INSERT model state and proxy remap provenance. It rejects unsupported nested aliases, EED/appdata, attributes and data-storage state before making the bounded temporary copy. No new DRW_Interface virtual callback or public consumer behavior changes.
Previous model-only and source-only selections remain available. DRW_Interface default addTable forwarding to an insert-only callback is unchanged.

physical_source.result: PASS: one source-bound TABLE model and its retained INSERT projection bind with the reciprocal dictionary and other selected source frames; unrelated HEADER integrity observation remains.
controls: Projection position, name, xdictionary and proxy mutation, removal, duplicate distinct object, duplicate same pointer and mBlock/container alias revoke the whole capability and pass after restoration.
Exact 100000 retained-entity scan budget succeeds, 100001 is refused, and container restoration succeeds.
The older model-only selection intentionally remains valid when its independent 2D projection is edited.
A spoofed TABLE callback, block replay exception, same/cross-adapter reentry, wrong selection, TABLE snapshot or ticket allocation failure refuse and permit clean retry.
A valid stronger bundle still fails strict DXF output and preserves the destination sentinel.
End-to-end query used 2850 allocations in this build; its last allocation was faulted and retried. This is sampled, not exhaustive.

automated_generated_tests.controls: Locally authored bounded TABLE and matching INSERT projection with geometry, xdictionary, layer, proxy, subtype, EED/attribute and size negative cases; every observed comparator allocation faulted and retried. A DRW_Interface default addTable call reaches an insert-only override with the original dynamic TABLE. Other source-bundle and TABLESTYLE compatibility tests pass.
automated_generated_tests.limits: Full projection bundle integration uses a local scratch physical source; the generated comparator does not construct a complete populated DWG graph.

limitations: Only the selected complete AC1018 3x3 TABLE profile is considered. Projection comparison does not establish its block/container membership or separately emitted display primitives.

TABLESTYLE and wider resource closure, source/codepage semantics, independent semantic/native interoperability and atomic populated-output transaction remain open. This capability must never alone authorize output.
Physical full-bundle controls use one ODA-created source and no new DWG/DXF fixture is committed. End-to-end allocation failures are sampled, not swept.
